subject: Workplace Skills
title: Shared Docs Over Email Chains
description: A quick, practical guide to Shared Docs Over Email Chains.

hook.text: An email chain with 14 versions of a document attached. Nobody knew which was the latest.

buildup.text: Email creates parallel versions. Each recipient may edit a different copy and knowledge diverges.

discovery.text: Shared documents with version history are the single source of truth. Everyone edits the same live copy.

twist.text: Comments in a shared doc stay attached to the context. Email threads lose context within three replies.

climax.text: For any collaborative work, start a shared doc from day one. Share the link, not the file.

punchline.text: Share the link, not the file. One source of truth.

quiz.question: Why are shared documents better than email attachments for collaboration?
options: Everyone edits the same live copy, preventing version conflicts
